subtitle: GDPR-compliant agreement for processing personal data
introText: This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") forms part of the Contract for Services between the Platform (Processor) and the Customer (Controller) to reflect the parties' agreement with regard to the Processing of Personal Data in accordance with GDPR requirements.
term1Def: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person
term2Def: Any operation performed on personal data, whether or not by automated means
term3Def: The entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data
term4Def: The entity that processes personal data on behalf of the Controller
scopeIntro: This DPA applies to all processing of personal data by the Processor on behalf of the Controller in connection with the Platform Services.
obligation1Desc: The Processor shall process Personal Data only on documented instructions from the Controller
obligation2Desc: Ensure all personnel are subject to appropriate confidentiality obligations
obligation3Desc: Implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure security
obligation4Desc: Assist the Controller in ensuring compliance with GDPR obligations
securityIntro: The Processor implements and maintains the following security measures:
measure1Desc: AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit for all personal data
measure2Desc: Role-based access control with multi-factor authentication and principle of least privilege
measure3Desc: Firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and DDoS protection on all endpoints
measure4Desc: Logical separation of customer data with dedicated encryption keys per tenant
measure5Desc: Automated daily backups with point-in-time recovery and geo-redundant storage
measure6Desc: 24/7 security monitoring with comprehensive audit logs and anomaly detection
subprocessingIntro: The Controller provides general authorization for the Processor to engage sub-processors, subject to:
subReq1: Prior written notification of any intended changes
subReq2: Opportunity for the Controller to object to such changes
subReq3: Flow-down of all data protection obligations
subReq4: Processor remains fully liable for sub-processor performance
name: Name
rightsIntro: The Processor shall assist the Controller in fulfilling its obligations to respond to data subject requests:
right1Desc: Access personal data we process about them
right2Desc: Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data
right3Desc: Request deletion of personal data in certain circumstances
right4Desc: Restrict processing of personal data in specific situations
right5Desc: Receive personal data in a structured, machine-readable format
right6Desc: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
breach1Desc: Notify Controller without undue delay and within 24 hours of becoming aware
breach2Desc: Provide nature of breach, categories affected, and likely consequences
breach3Desc: Describe measures taken or proposed to address the breach
breach4Desc: Document all breaches and measures taken for compliance records
auditIntro: The Controller has the right to audit Processor compliance:
audit1Desc: Annual SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification reports
audit2Desc: Annual right to conduct on-site audits with 30 days notice
audit3Desc: Quarterly security assessment reports and penetration test results
returnIntro: Upon termination of services, the Processor shall:
return1Desc: Return all personal data in commonly used format
return2Desc: Securely delete all copies unless retention is required by law
return3Desc: Certify in writing that deletion has been completed
liability1Desc: The Processor shall be liable for damages caused by processing where it has not complied with GDPR obligations specifically directed to processors or acted outside or contrary to lawful instructions.
liability2Desc: Each party shall indemnify the other against all losses arising from breach of this DPA or applicable data protection laws.
